label: Совет
description: A 10-sentence usage card for совет (council; advice).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Совет' stays in the nominative as the predicate noun. 'Полезный' is the agreeing masculine adjective and 'очень' intensifies it. A natural way to praise a piece of advice.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Совет' is the accusative direct object of 'дать'; the inanimate masculine accusative matches the nominative. 'Тебе' is the dative recipient. A common offer of advice.
Strategic focus: Genitive after a verb of request. 'Совета' is the genitive singular, used after 'прошу' to ask for advice. 'Твоего' is the agreeing masculine genitive modifier meaning your advice.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'благодаря'. 'Совету' is the dative singular required by 'благодаря', meaning thanks to the advice. 'Врача' is genitive specifying the doctor's advice.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after a verb. 'Советом' is the instrumental singular required by 'воспользовался', meaning made use of the advice. 'Хорошим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В совете' uses the prepositional form 'совете' after 'в', meaning within his advice. 'Много мудрости' uses the genitive after a quantity word.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject, council sense. 'Совет' is nominative as the subject of 'принял'. 'Директоров' is genitive plural meaning board of directors. Here the noun means council rather than advice.

Strategic focus: Accusative after 'за'. 'Совет' is accusative after 'за' in the thanking formula; the inanimate masculine accusative matches the nominative. 'Полезный' is the agreeing masculine adjective.

missions.phrase: Друзья всегда дают мне хорошие советы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Советы' is the accusative plural object of 'дают'; for inanimate nouns the plural accusative matches the nominative. 'Хорошие' agrees in the plural and 'мне' is the dative recipient.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural under negation. 'Советов' is the genitive plural, used after the negated imperative 'не слушай'. 'Плохих' agrees in the plural genitive, warning against bad advice.
